preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 40 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each test case's length n is an integer between 1 and 40 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for n, s in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))
preconditions.description: Each string s has length exactly equal to its corresponding n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each string s consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line) == 1 and output_line.isdigit() for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip().isdigit())
postconditions.description: Each output line is a single digit representing the minimum k.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(output_line) <= n for n, output_line in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip().isdigit()))
postconditions.description: Each output k is an integer between 0 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(any(all(sorted(s) == list(s) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]) or (k := int(output_line)) > 0 and any(all(sorted(s) == list(s) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]) for k in range(1, n+1) for indices in combinations(range(n), k) for perm in permutations([s[i] for i in indices]) if all(s[i] == perm[j] if i in indices else s[i] == s[i] for i, j in zip(indices, range(k))) and sorted(s) == list(''.join([perm[j] if i in indices else s[i] for i, j in zip(range(n), range(k))] + [s[i] for i in range(n) if i not in indices])))) for n, output_line in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip().isdigit()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output k is the minimum number of characters to permute such that the resulting string is sorted alphabetically.
